New here?

Your first visitstep by step.

Here's exactly what happens, so there are no surprises.

  1. Get in touch

    Text or call Helen on 07718 339510 and tell her a little about what you're looking for. She'll suggest a class that suits you.

  2. Fill in a short health form

    It asks about injuries or conditions so Helen can adjust things for you. It stays private.

  3. Arrive ten minutes early

    Helen will show you round, explain what happens and find you a spot. At the back or by the door is fine.

  4. Go at your own pace

    Every exercise has an easier version. Rest whenever you like, and you can leave at any point.

What to bring

  • Comfortable clothes you can move in
  • A bottle of water
  • A towel for hot classes
  • Mats and props are here for you

Not sure which class to try? Start with something unheated, like one of our six-week groups or Yin.

Questions people ask

Is every class hot?

No. Plenty of our classes aren't heated at all, and others are warm rather than hot. Every class lists its temperature on the classes page.

Do I need to be fit or flexible?

No. Most people who walk in for the first time feel the same way, and every exercise has an easier option.

Can I leave if I need to?

Yes, any time, and nobody will ask why.

Are there stairs?

The gym is on the ground floor. The yoga studio is upstairs: 16 steps to a landing, then 10 more, and there's no lift. If stairs are hard for you, tell Helen and she'll suggest something downstairs. There's an accessible toilet with grab rails downstairs, and another toilet upstairs.

Is there parking?

parking details

How much is it?

Your first class is free with our leaflet. After that, see our prices. There are no contracts.
